Open the draft created by this plan.

args.goal: In the Manage Line Items window, select a product from the product dropdown, enter 90 in the Quantity field, enter 12$% in the price field, click Save, and record the application's visible response to the special-character price.

steps.note: Perform the exact buyer-side interaction that no specialized catalog step can express.
Assert the resulting screen has no crash, server error, or raw error artifacts.
